{{Quote|This is where the ''fun'' begins.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 1">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 1|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>}}
During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flew a '''Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor'''.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Artoo, stay with the ship.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 1" />}}
Anakin Skywalker's craft had bright yellow markings similar to his previous [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] and the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] he piloted as a child on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
{{Quote|Hang on, Artoo! We're almost clear.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Obsession 3">[[Obsession 3|''Obsession'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:JediInterceptors.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Skywalker's Eta-2 alongside [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Kenobi's Eta-2 interceptor]] at the Battle of Coruscant.]]

With the arrival of the new interceptors, Anakin began using this [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] instead of his yellow [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]]. He flew his Eta-2 in numerous battles during the closing days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], proving time and again his superiority as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Often at his side was his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], in a gray and maroon-colored Eta-2 interceptor. Although he was impressed with Anakin's skill, Obi-Wan often remarked on Anakin's reckless piloting. Obi-Wan and other Jedi were also concerned about Anakin's obsession and possessive attitude toward the ships he had for personal use. [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], however, often encouraged the young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to continue making modifications and enhancements to his ships.

Around 20 BBY, he used this fighter on Cato Neimoidia after the Separatists launched an [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|attack]] on the planet. During the battle, a [[Discord missile/Legends|Discord missile]] was fired at his ship, causing a swarm of buzz droids to land on it. Skywalker and his droid R2-D2 were fighting them off, but one managed to hover under the ship and cause damage to the ship which made it malfunction and crash.

During the assault on the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], Anakin used his interceptor's weapons to disable the ''Hand''{{'s}} hangar shields. Anakin then crash-landed his ship inside that [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay, and it was destroyed as the infamous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] plummeted into the atmosphere of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

After Anakin became Darth Vader, he briefly flew a [[Darth Vader's green Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|green Eta-2 interceptor]]<ref name="RotS" /> and later a [[Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|black one]], keeping several craft identical to the latter in reserve.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] markings on the sides of the craft read "Elbert Maria," but it is as of yet unknown what this refers to.
